assets.caption: Repeatedly used brood comb. Darker cell interiors show retained pupal lining from repeated brood cycles; colour alone is not a diagnosis of disease, residues or contamination.
assets.editorial_boundary: Use history and pupal lining are visible; do not infer disease, pesticide residues, treatment residues or contamination from colour alone.
